observation: Front, top and iso re-inspected on the closed stored state after the fork-prong and crescent repairs. The front view down the slit meridian now shows the dome with an open shutter slot, the telescope tube standing in it and a fork prong either side, seated on the base with the counters stored beneath and visible through the lowered sill spans. Roof still square on the four corner ledges with an even gap all round; plate covers the 184 mm opening. No misplaced, missing or extra parts, no visible intersections, no floating geometry.
